test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The simple interest received on a sum at the rate of 8 percent per annum is 2/5 of the sum. What is the time period?
solution:
Given:

The simple interest received on a sum at the rate of 8 percent per annum is 2/5 of the sum

Formula used:

Simple interest = P × R × T / 100 [ P = principal, R = rate of interest, T = time]

Calculation:

Let, P = principal. Time = T

Interest is 2P / 5

As per the question,

⇒ 2P / 5 = P × 8 × T / 100

⇒ T = 20 / 4

⇒ T = 5 years

**∴ The correct option is **2
